findings.why_it_matters: 47db044's message goes to unusual lengths to itemize all 26 findings it claims to address or defer by id (src#1-2, ext#1-4, built-html#1-3, cold-reader#1-4 + carried, op#1-4, rationale#1-2, templates#1-3) plus 6 deferred ids -- a level of precision this audit lane exists to check because the author is finder, fixer and reporter at once. This one-word terminology correction in Design.jl (the only touched file with no bullet naming it, 'rubric' vs the vocabulary's actual term 'persona' used consistently elsewhere in Preflight.jl) has no matching id in either the addressed or the deferred list, so a reader auditing the round against its own commit message cannot account for every line the diff actually touched. The edit itself is correct and harmless -- verified 'persona' is the term this package's config vocabulary actually uses for a hat -- so this is a completeness gap in the self-report, not a behavioural or scope problem.
findings.description: The commit message for 47db044 itemizes every other touched file's finding id precisely, but the Design.jl edit to calibrate()'s docstring is present in the diff with no corresponding bullet, deferred item, or code-claim covering it -- a small but real drive-by against an otherwise complete self-report.
findings.evidence: git show 47db044 -- src/CLI/Design.jl shows the sole hunk in that file; the commit message's full bullet list (src#1, src#2, ext#1-3, built-html#1, built-html#2-3, cold-reader#1-4 + carried cold-reader#1, op#1-4, rationale#1-2, templates#1-3, plus the deferred ids) contains no mention of Design.jl, calibrate, rubric, or persona.
